name: DeForest
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in DeForest, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in DeForest and Windsor, Wisconsin for 2026: tree lighting, Santa, library programs and Windsor Wonderland.
lede: DeForest runs a Winterfest weekend with a tree lighting, cinnamon rolls with Santa and library programs, and neighboring Windsor adds a free Wonderland with live reindeer.
celebrates: The Village of DeForest describes Winterfest as a cherished DeForest tradition, and the 2026 version starts on Thursday, December 3, with the Community Holiday Tree Lighting at Fireman's Park from 5 to 7 pm. Hot cocoa and cookies have been part of past tree lightings, according to local news coverage, and a surprise visitor from the North Pole arrives at 5:30 pm. On Saturday, December 5, Cinnamon Rolls with Santa is held at Cornerstone Community Center, and DeForest Area Public Library hosts holiday music, ornament making and board games. The same Saturday, the Village of Windsor holds Windsor Wonderland with Santa, live reindeer and bonfires.
lastyear: The DeForest community tree lighting was described by local news as a first annual event when it began, with the village saying it was blown away by the response of the community. A later report in the Star said the annual tree lighting took place at Fireman's Park, where the shelter's fireplace was lit and hot cocoa was served to help keep folks warm. We did not find a published 2025 recap with attendance, so this page leans on those host and news posts.
facts: DeForest's Fireman's Park has a shelter with a fireplace, and local news reports that it was lit for the tree lighting to keep families warm. Cornerstone Community Center, on North Main Street, hosts the cinnamon roll breakfast with Santa, and the Winterfest page says that Family Prize Bingo follows in the afternoon. Windsor, just east of DeForest, hosts its own holiday day on December 5 with live reindeer and bonfires at its Fireman's Park.
trains: DeForest does not have its own holiday train, but several are within reach. CPKC's free Holiday Train stops in Columbus on December 9 and in Portage and Wisconsin Dells on December 10, and Mid-Continent Railway Museum in North Freedom runs its Santa Express through December 12. Our museum guide lists Mid-Continent with tickets and kids tips, and the Santa Express sells out, so book early on the museum's own site before you plan the drive from DeForest.
train_links: A heritage railroad museum with a 7 mile, 55 minute ride and Santa Express weekends, listed on our museum guide.

faq: DeForest holds Winterfest, which the village calls a cherished tradition. It begins with the Community Holiday Tree Lighting at Fireman's Park on December 3 and continues on December 5 with Cinnamon Rolls with Santa, a craft fair, library programs and bingo, all listed on the village calendar.
Where is the DeForest tree lighting?

The Village of DeForest lists the Community Holiday Tree Lighting at Fireman's Park on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 5 to 7 pm. A surprise visitor from the North Pole is scheduled for 5:30 pm, and past years offered hot cocoa and cookies in the park shelter, according to local news.
Can kids meet Santa in DeForest?

Yes. Cinnamon Rolls with Santa runs from 8:30 to 10:30 am on Saturday, December 5, at Cornerstone Community Center, 505 N. Main Street, and Windsor Wonderland offers Santa photos at Windsor Village Hall from 2 to 4 pm the same day. The Windsor event is free according to the village flyer.

The Village of Windsor presents Windsor Wonderland on Saturday, December 5, from 2 to 6 pm. Indoor photos with Santa, crafts with Mrs. Claus and live music are at Windsor Village Hall, and live reindeer, carolers, bonfires, hot chocolate and cookies follow at Fireman's Park. The flyer says it is free to attend.
